newsitem.title: ITALY: Italian taxi drivers strike for the day.
newsitem.headline: Italian taxi drivers strike for the day.

text.p: Taxi drivers went on strike across Italy on Tuesday in a dispute with the government over working conditions.
Commuters in Rome and other major centres were forced to find alternative means of transport, with many people walking to work rather than board packed buses and trains.
Taxi driver unions said the strike was called to protest against an increase in licence costs and to demand a revision of the country's highway code.
The 24-hour stoppage was the latest in a wave of strikes to hit Italy this year. Local public transport workers went on strike last month in a long-running contract dispute.
In April, Rome came to a virtual standstill when local transport unions staged a 24-hour wildcat strike. Air traffic controllers, railway and port workers have also taken industrial action this year.
